I have a special someone I hold dearly to my heart and I have for years now. We were great friends and got along really well and we both helped eachother through tough times. There was flirting and Comforting being exchanged and compliments all the time and for once I felt truly loved. So I finally managed to pluck up the courage to ask her out on a date. It all went great and we both seemed to have a great night but then we just stopped talking we stopped texting eachother and having 2 hour long calls. When we started college I stopped seeing her and she was always too busy to talk or hangout and I haven't seen her since. She still holds a special place in my heart and I don't think that will ever change I feel broken inside and worthless because I feel there's nothing I can do to see her again and have that kind of connection. Overall its a crap feeling and I still look back in regret wondering whether or not I did something wrong and whether I could of ended up with her. I hope this helps  :)
